bug: When add_piece reveals the next real piece, the first speculative DAG layer is converted to a known layer and its children are narrowed to that piece, but node.eval is copied from the pre-reveal bag-average value and the changed value is not propagated through the preceding known layers.
fix: For expanded nodes in the despeculated layer, recompute node.eval from the revealed piece's best child, then directly backprop changed values through all preceding known layers using the H12-corrected best-child demotion logic. Preserve old eval for unexpanded nodes.
